scores.visual_critic_note: Deliberate Paul Tol palette, clean typographic hierarchy with monospace count labels, and a well-structured legend elevate this above generic, but the lower half of the viewport is empty dead space at initial render and the hot-pink match highlight circles clash with the otherwise restrained palette.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Tree layout has no quantitative axes or size-encoded magnitudes to distort; color encodes categorical rank correctly, node radii are fixed by type (not data-driven scale), SVG dimensions derive from d3.extent/d3.max over the actual layout, and the only mild issue is the data-join key (name+depth) which could collide if names repeated at the same depth.
scores.stress_test_note: No .interrupt() call before new transitions in update(), so rapid node clicks or expand-all/collapse-all during a 500ms animation will cause jumping elements; search is properly debounced at 200ms and pointer events correctly unify mouse/touch with no other interaction robustness violations.
scores.cognitive_load_note: Single view with 6 perceptually distinct rank colors and progressive disclosure of ~200 nodes keeps default state clean; collapsed +N counts and search-to-expand reduce working memory load well.

proposer: Removed 4 lines of dead `.badge` CSS that no element in the visualization uses. 557 → 553 lines.
